- [EVENT] User is thinking of hosting a family game night soon and wants to plan some fun activities.

- [EVENT] User is looking for recommendations for games that are a bit more strategic, like Ticket to Ride.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant describes Azul as a tile-laying game for 2-4 players, taking 30-45 minutes to play, with the objective of creating a mosaic by collecting and placing tiles.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant explains the gameplay of Azul, including drafting tiles, placing them on the player board, scoring points, and the game's end conditions.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant highlights why Azul is great: easy to learn, strategic depth, high replayability, beautiful components, and family-friendly.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provides tips for playing Azul, such as focusing on creating sets, blocking opponents, planning ahead, and managing tiles.
- [PREFERENCE] User expresses interest in getting Azul after their great experience at a board game cafe.
- [EVENT] User has been meaning to buy the expansion pack for Ticket to Ride since they saw it at the game store near their house last month.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommends other games similar to Ticket to Ride: Elfenland, Trains, Russian Railroads, Age of Steam, and Rails of Europe.
